title: L1: Controlling How Long A Reasoning Model Thinks With Reinforcement Learning
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: L1 trains DeepScaleR-based policies with programmatic final-answer and token-budget rewards so a prompt can request either an exact reasoning length or a maximum token ceiling.
L1 以正确性和长度约束奖励使推理长度成为提示词可控的测试时计算预算。
why: It makes inference budget a first-class field of the rollout and reward contract: each source problem is paired with a requested length, the policy generates an on-policy trace, and correctness plus realized length determine reward. For Track 5, this separates learned budget-conditioned trajectories from hard truncation, while the missing complete rollout/reward ledger limits data-level reuse and audit.
inclusion_reason: A direct Track 5 test-time-compute recipe: it converts a sampled token budget into prompt conditioning and an online reward contract, producing full reasoning rollouts whose correctness and budget adherence are scored without gold intermediate traces.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning models often spend more tokens on difficult problems, but ordinary long-CoT models do not let a caller choose that budget. Their outputs may run for tens of thousands of tokens or stop before a hard problem is solved. Test-time budget forcing can truncate a solution mid-step or insert continuation tokens without teaching the policy how to reorganize its reasoning.

L1 asks whether token budget can become an explicit conditioning variable learned through reinforcement learning. The LCPO training object starts from a mathematical problem and final answer, appends an exact-length or maximum-length request, and obtains an on-policy reasoning response. No gold intermediate rationale is required; programmatic final-answer correctness and realized token count provide the feedback.

For this atlas, the important object is the budget-conditioned rollout and its reward record, not only the released model. A reusable record would connect the source item, requested budget, full generated response, extracted answer, actual length, correctness signal, and length-adherence signal. The official release provides code and models, but a complete paper-matched training-rollout corpus was not verified.

推理模型往往会在困难问题上使用更多 token，但普通长 CoT 模型无法让调用方指定这一预算。输出可能延伸到数万 token，也可能在难题尚未解决时提前结束。测试时的 budget forcing 可能在步骤中间截断解答，或插入续写 token，却没有教会策略重新组织推理。

L1 研究能否把 token 预算变成由强化学习掌握的显式条件变量。LCPO 的训练对象从数学问题和最终答案出发，追加精确长度或最大长度请求，再获得策略在线生成的推理响应。它不需要 gold 中间 rationale；程序化的最终答案正确性与实际 token 数共同提供反馈。

对本图谱而言，关键对象是预算条件化 rollout 及其奖励记录，而不只是发布的模型。可复用记录应连接源条目、请求预算、完整生成响应、抽取答案、实际长度、正确性信号和长度遵守信号。官方发布了代码和模型，但未核验到完整、与论文匹配的训练 rollout 语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Length Controlled Policy Optimization (LCPO) appends a token request to each source prompt and optimizes an on-policy response with GRPO. L1-Exact combines binary final-answer correctness with a penalty proportional to the absolute difference between requested and realized length. The paper fixes the exact-mode trade-off coefficient at 0.0003, so the policy is rewarded for solving the problem while approaching the requested count.

L1-Max continues from L1-Exact with a soft maximum-length objective. It permits a correct response to finish below the ceiling and gradually penalizes violations instead of hard-truncating the sequence; the model retains both exact and maximum modes according to the prompt. Thus the policy, not an external truncator, learns whether to compress or expand its reasoning.

The feedback contract is programmatic but narrow. Boxed-answer extraction and mathd/SymPy equivalence checks judge the terminal answer, while token counting judges budget adherence. Neither signal certifies the semantic validity or faithfulness of the intermediate chain.

Length Controlled Policy Optimization（LCPO）在每条源提示后追加 token 请求，并通过 GRPO 优化策略在线生成的响应。L1-Exact 把二值最终答案正确性与“请求长度和实际长度之差”的惩罚结合起来；论文将精确模式的权衡系数固定为 0.0003，使策略在解题的同时逼近指定 token 数。

L1-Max 从 L1-Exact 继续训练，采用软最大长度目标。正确响应可以在上限内提前结束，超出预算时逐步受罚，而不是被硬截断；模型根据提示同时保留精确模式与最大模式。因此，决定如何压缩或展开推理的是策略本身，而不是外部截断器。

该反馈契约是程序化但范围有限的：\boxed{} 答案抽取以及 mathd/SymPy 等价检查判断终局答案，token 计数判断预算遵守。两者都不能证明中间推理链在语义上有效或忠实。

title: Method
方法
html:
The training source is DeepScaleR-Preview-Dataset, described as 40K mathematical question-answer pairs drawn from AIME, AMC, Omni-Math, and STILL. The public preprocessing script loads the DeepScaleR training split, adds an instruction to return a boxed answer, samples an exact or maximum token request, and serializes the prompt with its ground-truth answer and requested length. Its default exact-target code samples integer lengths from 100 to 4,000; the paper evaluates 512, 1,024, 2,048, and 3,600-token requests.

The main base is DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview, itself RL-fine-tuned from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B. LCPO-Exact runs in VeRL for 700 GRPO steps with learning rate 1e-6, batch size 128, and a 4K training context. L1-Max then receives 120 additional RL steps. Evaluation extends the context to 8K; the paper also reports an appendix extension to a 7B model.

The released reward implementation extracts a boxed answer after the reasoning delimiter and applies mathd or SymPy equivalence checks. It separately scores the realized token count, then combines correctness and length according to Exact or Max mode. The official repository includes preprocessing, training, evaluation, replication scripts, model outputs, and an MIT license; the official Hugging Face collection exposes multiple Exact/Max model checkpoints. A paper-complete dataset of all requested budgets, on-policy rollouts, component rewards, failures, and seeds was not verified.

训练来源是 DeepScaleR-Preview-Dataset，论文将其描述为从 AIME、AMC、Omni-Math 和 STILL 汇集的 40K 个数学问题—答案对。公开预处理脚本读取 DeepScaleR 训练切分，加入要求输出 \boxed{} 答案的指令，采样精确或最大 token 请求，并把提示、ground-truth 答案与请求长度序列化。其默认精确目标代码从 100 到 4,000 均匀采样整数长度；论文评测 512、1,024、2,048 和 3,600-token 请求。

主实验基座是 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview，它本身由 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 经 RL 微调而来。LCPO-Exact 在 VeRL 中运行 700 个 GRPO step，学习率为 1e-6、batch size 为 128、训练上下文为 4K；L1-Max 随后再进行 120 个 RL step。评测上下文扩展至 8K，论文附录还报告了 7B 模型扩展。

发布的奖励实现会在推理分隔符后抽取 boxed 答案，并使用 mathd 或 SymPy 做等价检查；同时单独计算实际 token 数，再按 Exact 或 Max 模式组合正确性与长度。官方仓库包含预处理、训练、评测、复现实验脚本、model outputs 和 MIT 许可证，官方 Hugging Face 集合提供多个 Exact/Max checkpoint。未核验到涵盖全部请求预算、在线 rollout、奖励分量、失败和随机种子的论文完整数据集。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The COLM 2025/OpenReview record, arXiv:2503.04697, official CMU L3 project page, cmu-l3/l1 repository, and l3lab Hugging Face collection establish the citation, method description, code surface, and model artifacts. The project page also supplies the official arXiv BibTeX. These sources verify artifact availability, not completeness of the training-rollout data.

The paper reports control curves over multiple budgets, approximately 3% mean length deviation on its mathematical evaluations, and 20-40% deviation on out-of-domain tasks. It evaluates AIME 2025, MATH, AMC, Olympiad-Bench, GPQA, LSAT, and MMLU; it also reports reward ablations, SFT-only failure, sampling-temperature robustness, and a 7B extension. These experiments support the claim that the trained policy responds to token instructions under the studied setup.

They do not establish that the generated chains are logically valid, faithful, licensed as a standalone corpus, deduplicated, or free of training/evaluation overlap. Benchmark gains are model-and-selector outcomes under a coupled base model, source mixture, reward, optimizer, and context budget; they are not evidence that every rollout is high-quality training data.

COLM 2025/OpenReview 记录、arXiv:2503.04697、CMU L3 官方项目页、cmu-l3/l1 仓库和 l3lab Hugging Face 集合共同核验了引文、方法描述、代码表面与模型工件。项目页还提供官方 arXiv BibTeX。这些来源证明工件存在，但不能证明训练 rollout 数据完整。

论文报告了多个预算下的控制曲线：数学评测的平均长度偏差约为 3%，域外任务约为 20–40%。评测覆盖 AIME 2025、MATH、AMC、Olympiad-Bench、GPQA、LSAT 与 MMLU；论文还报告奖励消融、仅 SFT 的失败、采样温度鲁棒性和 7B 扩展。这些实验支持“训练后的策略会在受测设置中响应 token 指令”这一主张。

它们不能证明生成链在逻辑上有效、忠实、可作为独立语料授权、已经去重或不存在训练—评测重叠。Benchmark 提升是基座模型、来源混合、奖励、优化器与上下文预算耦合后的模型和选择结果，并不是每条 rollout 都是高质量训练数据的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Relative to S1-style budget forcing, LCPO moves length control from an inference-time intervention into the training objective. Instead of truncating a response or inserting continuation tokens until a quota is reached, it conditions the policy on a budget and rewards both terminal correctness and realized length. This turns requested compute into a field of the prompt/rollout/reward record.

Relative to supervised length labels, the paper's key data-facing change is online feedback. Its SFT-only ablation relabels generated traces with their lengths but still fails to make the model follow requested budgets; LCPO continually evaluates newly generated responses against the requested length. L1-Max further distinguishes a ceiling from an exact target, avoiding the requirement to fill unused budget.

The novelty should remain scoped to learned length control for the studied reasoning policies. The method does not introduce step-correctness supervision, a new mathematical answer verifier, or a curated trace corpus, and its budget signal does not identify which reasoning content should be retained.

相较于 S1 式 budget forcing，LCPO 把长度控制从测试时干预移入训练目标。它不在配额耗尽时截断响应，也不反复插入续写 token，而是用预算条件化策略，并同时奖励终局正确性与实际长度。这使“请求的算力”成为提示、rollout 和奖励记录中的一级字段。

相较于监督式长度标签，论文在数据层面的关键变化是在线反馈。其仅 SFT 消融把生成轨迹按长度重新标注，却仍不能让模型遵守请求预算；LCPO 则持续依据请求长度评估新生成响应。L1-Max 还把“上限”与“精确目标”区分开，避免强制填满未使用预算。

创新性应限定为对受测推理策略进行学习式长度控制。该方法没有引入步骤正确性监督、新的数学答案验证器或经整理的轨迹语料，而且预算信号本身也不能识别应保留哪些推理内容。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Exact-length optimization can reward padding, repetition, or unnatural expansion/compression because meeting the token count is part of the objective. L1-Max removes the requirement to fill the budget, but the paper's additive Max-reward ablation collapses to extremely short CoTs that satisfy the ceiling while harming performance. Reward design therefore changes what trajectories are generated, not just their length.

Correctness is attached to the extracted final answer, while intermediate reasoning receives no direct validity signal. A rollout can pass mathd/SymPy checking despite unsupported intermediate claims. Conversely, extraction or symbolic-normalization failures can mark a semantically correct response wrong. Token count measures resource use, not information content.

Training is concentrated on DeepScaleR mathematical QA. Length deviation rises from about 3% on math evaluations to 20-40% on reported OOD tasks, so control does not transfer uniformly. The paper states that hyperparameters were not extensively tuned, and 4K training contexts change the regime of a 24K-context base.

No complete paper-matched ledger of source versions, target requests, GRPO groups, rollouts, component rewards, seeds, failures, or rejected records was verified. Comprehensive decontamination and overlap manifests are also absent; the source mixture contains AIME/AMC-derived material, and the paper itself flags significant contamination in one short-CoT comparison.

精确长度优化可能奖励填充、重复或不自然的扩写/压缩，因为命中 token 数本身就是目标的一部分。L1-Max 不再要求填满预算，但论文中的加法式 Max 奖励消融会坍缩到极短 CoT：它们遵守上限，却损害任务表现。因此，奖励设计改变的不只是长度，也包括生成出的轨迹类型。

正确性只附着在抽取的最终答案上，中间推理没有直接有效性信号。rollout 即使包含无根据的中间论断，也可能通过 mathd/SymPy 检查；反过来，答案抽取或符号归一化失败也可能把语义正确响应判错。Token 数衡量资源使用，而非信息含量。

训练集中于 DeepScaleR 数学问答。论文报告的长度偏差从数学评测约 3% 上升到域外任务的 20–40%，说明控制能力并非均匀迁移。作者说明未广泛调参，而且 4K 训练上下文改变了原 24K-context 基座的工作区间。

未核验到涵盖来源版本、目标请求、GRPO group、rollout、奖励分量、随机种子、失败和拒绝记录的论文完整台账。也没有完整的去污染与重叠清单；来源混合包含 AIME/AMC 衍生材料，论文自身还在一项短 CoT 对比中标注了显著污染。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 5, L1 is a concrete example of turning test-time compute into a trainable trajectory condition rather than applying a post-hoc truncation rule. It exposes three objects that should remain separate in an atlas record: the source problem-answer pair, the on-policy reasoning rollout under a requested budget, and the correctness/length reward record.

The official scripts and checkpoints can support recipe-level reproduction, controlled generation at several token budgets, reward ablations, and comparison of exact versus ceiling semantics. A reusable dataset derived from this recipe should preserve the source revision and item ID, prompt template, exact/max mode, requested and realized tokens, full response, extracted answer, checker result, each reward component, termination cause, GRPO group, seed, and model/checkpoint revision.

Auditors can use those fields to test padding, repetition, verifier errors, difficulty-conditioned budget allocation, and training/evaluation overlap. Until paper-matched rollout and reward records are released or reconstructed under a pinned commit, the work is most reusable as an RLVR/test-time-compute recipe and model release, not as a ready-made trace dataset.

对 Track 5 而言，L1 是把测试时算力变成可训练轨迹条件、而非事后截断规则的具体案例。图谱记录应把三类对象分开：源问题—答案对、在请求预算下由策略在线生成的推理 rollout，以及正确性/长度奖励记录。

官方脚本和 checkpoint 可支持配方级复现、多个 token 预算下的受控生成、奖励消融以及精确目标与上限语义的比较。由该配方构建的可复用数据集应保存来源版本和条目 ID、提示模板、Exact/Max 模式、请求与实际 token 数、完整响应、抽取答案、检查器结果、各奖励分量、终止原因、GRPO group、随机种子和模型/checkpoint 版本。

审计者可利用这些字段检查填充、重复、验证器错误、按难度分配预算以及训练—评测重叠。在论文对应的 rollout 和奖励记录被发布，或基于固定 commit 重建之前，该工作最适合作为 RLVR/测试时算力配方与模型发布复用，而不是现成的轨迹数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate L1-Exact from L1-Max: one rewards proximity to a requested count, while the other uses a soft ceiling and permits early completion.
  • Distinguish the 40K DeepScaleR source problem-answer pool from on-policy LCPO rollouts; LCPO does not require gold intermediate traces.
  • Treat boxed-answer equivalence and token count as two programmatic feedback fields, neither of which verifies intermediate reasoning.
  • Read the reported approximately 3% math length deviation beside the 20-40% OOD deviation; budget control does not transfer uniformly.
  • The official release includes code, models, preprocessing, replication scripts, and some model outputs, but no verified complete GRPO rollout/reward ledger.
  • Benchmark gains measure the coupled trained system and must not be used as proof of rollout-data quality or freedom from contamination.

• 区分 L1-Exact 与 L1-Max：前者奖励接近指定 token 数，后者使用软上限并允许提前结束。
  • 区分 40K DeepScaleR 源问题—答案池与 LCPO 在线 rollout；LCPO 不需要 gold 中间轨迹。
  • 把 boxed 答案等价检查与 token 计数视为两个程序化反馈字段；二者都不验证中间推理。
  • 应把数学任务约 3% 的长度偏差与域外任务 20–40% 的偏差并读；预算控制不会均匀迁移。
  • 官方发布包含代码、模型、预处理、复现实验脚本和部分 model outputs，但没有核验到完整 GRPO rollout/奖励台账。
  • Benchmark 提升衡量的是耦合后的训练系统，不能作为 rollout 数据质量或无污染的证明。

value_zh.html: LCPO 不使用由正确性触发的环境终止状态或推断时硬截断器。生成经模型/运行时停止条件或上下文限制结束，之后对正确性与实际长度打分。L1-Max 软惩罚预算违规，而非保证每条回复都低于所请求上限。

value.html: DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview, a 1.5B model previously RL-fine-tuned from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B on the DeepScaleR-Preview data with a 24K context. The paper also reports an appendix extension to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B; the main L1-Exact/L1-Max recipe uses the 1.5B base.

value_zh.html: DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview，一个先前在 DeepScaleR-Preview 数据上、以 24K 上下文从 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 经 RL 微调的 1.5B 模型。论文还报告了对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B 的附录扩展；主要 L1-Exact/L1-Max 配方使用 1.5B 基座。

value.html: No separate teacher generates LCPO target traces. The inherited base-model lineage includes DeepSeek-R1 distillation, but LCPO itself operates on final-answer supervision and on-policy rollouts.

value_zh.html: 无单独教师模型生成 LCPO 目标轨迹。继承的基座模型谱系包括 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏，但 LCPO 本身在最终答案监督与 on-policy rollout 上运行。

value.html: DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview initializes the on-policy generator; 700 LCPO-Exact GRPO steps produce L1-Exact, followed by 120 additional RL steps with the maximum-length objective to produce L1-Max.

value_zh.html: DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview 初始化 on-policy 生成器；700 步 LCPO-Exact GRPO 产生 L1-Exact，随后再以最大长度目标进行 120 步额外 RL 以产生 L1-Max。

value.html: During training, an exact or maximum token request is appended to each problem and the target length is sampled uniformly. The released preprocessing script samples integer targets from 100 to 4,000 by default and also exposes logarithmic, unconstrained, and mixed exact/max modes. The paper evaluates fixed requests of 512, 1,024, 2,048, and 3,600 tokens. Per-prompt GRPO group size, complete rollout counts, seeds, and a paper-pinned decoding configuration were not verified.

value_zh.html: 训练期间，每个问题附加精确或最大 token 请求，目标长度均匀采样。已发布预处理脚本默认从 100 到 4,000 采样整数目标，并暴露对数、无约束与混合 exact/max 模式。论文评测 512、1,024、2,048 与 3,600 token 的固定请求。未核验逐提示 GRPO 组大小、完整 rollout 计数、种子与论文钉扎的解码配置。

value.html: The main training and evaluation decoding temperature was not identified in the paper metadata. An appendix robustness study varies inference temperature from 0.0 to 1.0; this sweep is evidence about robustness, not a replacement for the paper-matched training setting.

value_zh.html: 论文元数据中未识别主要训练与评测解码温度。附录稳健性研究将推断温度从 0.0 变化到 1.0；该扫描是关于稳健性的证据，不能替代与论文匹配的训练设定。

value.html: The paper identifies the 40K DeepScaleR-Preview question-answer collection as the training source. The released preprocessing script extracts ground-truth answers, appends a sampled length instruction, and serializes prompt/reward metadata, but the paper and repository do not pin a paper-matched retained-row count, exclusion ledger, deduplication rule, or contamination filter.

value_zh.html: 论文将 40K 条 DeepScaleR-Preview 问答集合识别为训练来源。已发布预处理脚本提取标准答案、附加采样长度指令并序列化提示/奖励元数据，但论文与仓库未钉扎与论文匹配的保留行计数、排除账本、去重规则或污染过滤器。

value.html: Training is capped at a 4K context and evaluation at 8K. Reported control curves use requested budgets of 512, 1,024, 2,048, and 3,600 tokens; public preprocessing supports sampled integer requests from 100 to 4,000. Realized output length remains model-generated and can violate the requested budget.

value_zh.html: 训练上限为 4K 上下文，评测为 8K。所报告控制曲线使用 512、1,024、2,048 与 3,600 token 的请求预算；公开预处理支持从 100 到 4,000 的采样整数请求。实际输出长度仍由模型生成，可能违反所请求预算。

value.html: VeRL-based GRPO with learning rate 1e-6 and batch size 128. L1-Exact trains for 700 steps with the exact-length objective and coefficient 0.0003; L1-Max continues for 120 steps with a soft maximum-length objective and dual exact/max prompting. The paper states that hyperparameters were not extensively tuned.

value_zh.html: 基于 VeRL 的 GRPO，学习率 1e-6，batch size 128。L1-Exact 以精确长度目标与系数 0.0003 训练 700 步；L1-Max 以软最大长度目标与双重 exact/max 提示继续 120 步。论文称超参数未经广泛调优。

value.html: DeepScaleR-Preview 40K question-answer records (drawn from AIME, AMC, Omni-Math, and STILL) -> append a sampled exact/max token instruction -> on-policy GRPO rollouts from DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview -> programmatic final-answer and token-length reward -> L1-Exact -> additional maximum-length RL -> L1-Max. A row-level lineage and rollout/reward ledger was not verified.

value_zh.html: DeepScaleR-Preview 40K 条问答记录（来自 AIME、AMC、Omni-Math 与 STILL）-> 附加采样的 exact/max token 指令 -> 来自 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview 的 on-policy GRPO rollout -> 程序性最终答案与 token 长度奖励 -> L1-Exact -> 额外最大长度 RL -> L1-Max。未核验行级谱系与 rollout/奖励账本。

value.html: Training uses the DeepScaleR-Preview source. Evaluation covers AIME 2025, MATH, AMC, Olympiad-Bench, GPQA, LSAT, and MMLU. Exact source revisions, train/evaluation item manifests, and overlap accounting were not verified; this matters because the training source itself includes AIME- and AMC-derived items.

value_zh.html: 训练使用 DeepScaleR-Preview 来源。评测覆盖 AIME 2025、MATH、AMC、Olympiad-Bench、GPQA、LSAT 与 MMLU。未核验精确来源修订、train/评测条目清单与重叠核算；这很重要，因为训练来源本身包含源自 AIME 与 AMC 的条目。

items: Exact-length optimization can reward padding, repetition, or distorted reasoning merely to hit the requested token count. L1-Max reduces forced filling, but its reward still treats length as an optimization target rather than a semantic quality measure.

The released programmatic checker verifies an extracted final answer and token count, not the validity or faithfulness of intermediate reasoning. A correct final answer can coexist with unsupported or circular reasoning.
Reward-function choice is consequential: the paper reports that an additive L1-Max ablation collapses to extremely short outputs that satisfy the ceiling while degrading reasoning performance.

Training is concentrated on mathematical question-answer data. The paper reports about 3% mean length deviation on math tasks but 20-40% on out-of-domain tasks, so prompt-level budget control does not transfer uniformly.

The official repository exposes code, preprocessing, evaluation scripts, model outputs, and model checkpoints, but no verified paper-complete ledger of all target requests, GRPO rollouts, component rewards, failures, seeds, or retained/rejected records.

Benchmark comparisons remain vulnerable to lineage and contamination effects. The paper itself flags significant contamination in one short-CoT model comparison, while comprehensive decontamination and source/evaluation overlap manifests remain undisclosed.
精确长度优化可能奖励填充、重复或扭曲推理，仅为达到所请求 token 数。L1-Max 减少强制填满，但其奖励仍将长度视为优化目标而非语义质量度量。
已发布程序性检查器核验提取的最终答案与 token 数，而非中间推理的有效性或忠实性。正确最终答案可以与无依据或循环推理并存。
奖励函数选择事关重大：论文报告加性 L1-Max 消融会坍缩为极短输出，满足上限同时降低推理表现。
训练集中于数学问答数据。论文报告数学任务上约 3% 平均长度偏差，但域外任务上为 20-40%，因此提示级预算控制并非均匀迁移。
官方仓库公开代码、预处理、评测脚本、模型输出与模型 checkpoint，但无已核验的论文完整账本，涵盖全部目标请求、GRPO rollout、分量奖励、失败、种子或保留/拒绝记录。
基准比较仍易受谱系与污染效应影响。论文自身标出一次 short-CoT 模型比较中的显著污染，而全面去污染与来源/评测重叠清单仍未披露。

value.html: The official code repository is MIT-licensed. A single license covering the upstream DeepScaleR source mixture, generated rollouts, released model collection, and all evaluation material was not verified.

value_zh.html: 官方代码仓库为 MIT 许可。未核验覆盖上游 DeepScaleR 来源混合物、生成的 rollout、已发布模型集合与全部评测材料的单一许可。

value.html: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct -> DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B -> DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview using DeepScaleR-Preview math data -> LCPO-Exact on sampled token requests -> L1-Exact -> LCPO-Max continuation -> L1-Max. The public Hugging Face collection exposes multiple 1.5B, 7B, and 8B Exact/Max model artifacts, but not a complete versioned training-rollout corpus.

value_zh.html: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct -> DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B -> 使用 DeepScaleR-Preview 数学数据的 DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview -> 在采样 token 请求上的 LCPO-Exact -> L1-Exact -> LCPO-Max 续训 -> L1-Max。公开 Hugging Face collection 暴露多个 1.5B、7B 与 8B Exact/Max 模型产物，但不是完整的版本化训练-rollout 语料。
